This indicates a chain of interactions where Ipatasertib may influence the activity of Eremanthin, which then affects Granzyme B. The final score of 0.7144 suggests a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain. The evidence is supported by a series of target predictions, but the integration of these pathways requires further experimental validation to confirm the direct involvement of Ipatasertib in the regulation of Granzyme B.
